newsitem.title: UK: Spain's nuclear output hit record in 1996 - NucNet.
newsitem.headline: Spain's nuclear output hit record in 1996 - NucNet.

text.p: Production by Spain's nine nuclear power units hit a new record last year, reaching 56.2 billion kilowatt-hours or the equivalent of nearly a third of all electricity generated nationally, the nuclear news agency NucNet reported on Thursday.
The Swiss-based agency said the 1996 total was slightly higher than the previous record set in 1989 and was 1.4 percent higher than the 1995 figure.
The new record was attributed mainly to good plant performance, the agency added.
"This means that Spain is second only to South Korea in terms of performance, taking into account countries with nine or more nuclear units," NucNet said in a statement faxed to Reuters in London.

The statement, which cited the Spanish Nuclear Industry Forum as its source, said the total generating capacity of Spain's nuclear units would be increased by 606 megawatts by the year 2003, through a combination of steam generator replacement and turbine upgrades.
